dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: I saw a white-haired lady around these parts a couple of days ago. She was incredibly beautiful — had an extraordinary air about her to boot.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: But just as I wanted to get a closer look, she suddenly disappeared...

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Actually, now that I think about it, did I encounter some passing adeptus?

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Hey, it's a traveler. I'm free to chat if you want? While the sergeant's not here.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Who are you?

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: We're the Millelith guards for this area. I'm Hongyu, and that's Kun.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Liyue Harbor's a pretty safe place. I've not seen any big trouble the whole time I've been in uniform. Maybe you get a few more pickpockets and petty thieves around Chihu Rock, but that's about it.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Hey, have you heard about Lantern Rite?

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: It's a festival people in Liyue celebrate. Takes place on the night of the first full moon every year. It's the biggest festival of the whole year, too.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: On the night of the festival, the whole city lights lanterns all night long. It makes the place as bright as day.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Also, we have a special floating lantern too. Unique to Liyue. It's quite a sight to behold, and you won't find anything like it elsewhere.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Anyway, just thought if you're new in town, it's something you definitely wouldn't want to miss!

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rex Lapis' death...

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Whoa, come on now. When I said we could chat, I didn't mean sensitive topics like that. That's off limits.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Take it from me, no self-respecting Liyue local is gonna want to broach that topic lightly.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: ...Ahem, I must stay at my post. If there's nothing else you need, please leave me be.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Sorry, I have things to do.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: *sigh* Okay then. Shame, don't get this sort of freedom very often.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Anything interesting happening around here?

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: No, I wouldn't say that anything interesting has happened. But I did encounter something weird recently...

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: There was something not quite right about my house. If it wasn't a bowl or chopsticks moving all of a sudden, then it was a chair suddenly falling over.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: After talking things through with a friend, he introduced me to an exorcist named Chongyun. They say that he's a specialist in these bump-in-the-night matters.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: But the instant that exorcist walked into the room, all the strange happenings stopped right away! He didn't even have to work any thaumaturgy!

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: It truly is weird. I still have no idea how that might have happened...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About Rex Lapis' death...

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: I was there at the Rite of Descension too. The Qixing had ordered us to maintain absolute secrecy regarding the matter at the time.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: But now that the Rite of Parting is finished, everyone is aware of the situation. There's no need for us Millelith to keep silent about it any longer...

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: But even so... I'm sorry, I still can't bring myself to discuss this topic any further.

dialogues.speaker: Hongyu
dialogues.text: Rex Lapis... *sigh*
